args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with error rate 0.18. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release v2.3.0 in all regions.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), unhealthy with an error rate of 0.18.
2. **Identified target**: From the deployment history, v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production (v2.2.9 was older; v2.3.1-rc was staging-only and unhealthy).
3. **Rolled back**: Rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all production regions. The rollback completed successfully (`status: rolled_out`).
4. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy"), which paged the on-call engineer, describing the rollback to v2.3.0.
5. **Verified**: Post-rollback status shows checkout-api on v2.3.0 in all regions, healthy, with error rate down to 0.002.
